title: ES60002: Waste To Wealth: Microbial Intervention
text:
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Syllabus:Topics and LecturesIntroduction: Glimpses of microbial world towards
biofuel/bioenergy production frombiomass,Lectures=2Biomass characterization
(Biophysical, Biochemical, Physicochemical, thermal, etc.) ,Lectures=
2Microbial Growth kinetics of pure and mixed culture ,Lectures=4Mechanisms of
Reactions: Pathways involved in waste to energy production,Lectures= 5Metabolic
and media engineering in biomass conversion,Lectures= 4Microbiology of aerobes
and anaerobes,Lectures= 2Mechanism of bioconversion process ,Lectures=2Trends
in biofuel production: First, second, third and fourth generation biofuel
,Lectures2Biohydrogen ,Lectures=1Oleaginous biodiesel production,Lectures
2Microbial fuel cells ,Lectures=1Bioremediation of heavy metals, xenobiotics

development and its cost effective recovery,Lectures= 4Conventional and
nonconventional techniques adopted for product recovery and
itscharacterization,Lectures=3Bioindicators, Biomarker, Biosensor,
